input: Book a window seat for my flight to Tokyo

gold.taskTitle: Book a window seat for Tokyo flight
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to secure a window seat assignment on an upcoming flight to Tokyo.

questions.title: What is your flight date and departure city?
questions.description: Understand the specific travel date and origin city to locate the correct flight.

questions.title: Which airline are you flying with?
questions.description: Identify the airline so the correct booking platform or process can be used.

questions.title: Do you already have a booking reference or ticket?
questions.description: Determine whether the flight is already booked and a seat change is needed, or if the flight itself still needs to be booked.

questions.title: Which airport in Tokyo are you flying into?
questions.description: Confirm the destination airport, as Tokyo has two main airports: Haneda and Narita.

questions.title: Do you prefer a window seat on a specific side?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for left or right side of the aircraft, often for scenic views or sun avoidance.

questions.title: Are you flying economy, business, or first class?
questions.description: Identify the cabin class, as seat selection processes and availability differ by class.

questions.title: Is there a fee you are willing to pay for seat selection?
questions.description: Understand the user's budget tolerance for any seat selection charges the airline may apply.
